sql_query.query: UPDATE _appointment SET title = COALESCE($1, title), description = COALESCE($2, description), dateTime = COALESCE($3, dateTime), endDateTime = COALESCE($4, endDateTime), location = COALESCE($5, location), notes = COALESCE($6, notes), completed = COALESCE($7, completed), updatedAt = $8 WHERE id = $9 AND careRecipientId IN (SELECT id FROM _care_recipient WHERE primaryCaregiverId = $10)
